question: If Daphne-chan wanted to, could she create a super-mabeasts with the special abilities of the White Whale, Great Rabbit, and Black Snake?
answer: As you’d expect, she can’t create a mabeast with more power than she herself has. It’s another matter if the mabeast grows stronger. It’s impossible if, by a mabeast that’s “stronger than she is”, we mean the Three Great Mabeasts. Do you understand what I’m saying? (note: I’m not confident in the translation of the third sentence. He may be implying that the Three Great Mabeasts were weaker when they were created, or that there’s some method of bypassing this power restriction.)
